title: IELTS Grammar Practice - IELTS Grammar - Subject-Verb Agreement
subject: IELTS Grammar

questions.q: Neither of the candidates ______ suitable for the position.
questions.explain: 'Neither' acts as a singular subject, so it takes the singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: IELTS Grammar

questions.q: A number of students ______ waiting outside.
questions.explain: 'A number of' takes a plural verb ('are'), whereas 'The number of' takes a singular verb.
questions.subject: IELTS Grammar
